sources.name: Open-Meteo Forecast API
sources.limitations: Model data, not a ground-station observation. No ward-level resolution. Free tier is not for commercial use.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
sources.coverage: Global, 1940 to present; ERA5 ~25 km, ERA5-Land ~11 km
sources.free_tier: Same non-commercial free-tier limits as the forecast API
sources.limitations: Reanalysis, not rain-gauge data; grid cells are far larger than a farm. The last few days come from recent model output instead.

sources.name: PlantDoc dataset
sources.limitations: Not validated for Nigerian field conditions. Does not cover several priority crops (verify class list).

sources.name: PlantVillage dataset
sources.license: Not yet verified for the source used
sources.limitations: Controlled backgrounds; poor proxy for field conditions. Pretraining only.

sources.name: NAFDAC pesticide register (NARPAD / Green Book)
sources.limitations: No verified bulk/API access. The app's pesticide list is empty until entries are added with a source and verification date.

sources.name: Crop calendar (draft entries)
sources.limitations: Not from an official agency. Not reviewed for Kano. Shown as DRAFT.

sources.name: Supabase
sources.free_tier: Free plan limits apply; check current pricing
sources.limitations: Free projects can pause after inactivity; verify current terms.

sources.name: Vercel
sources.free_tier: Hobby plan is for non-commercial use
sources.limitations: Request body limits apply to image uploads; commercial use needs a paid plan.

sources.name: Anthropic API (optional assistant)
sources.limitations: AI-generated text can be wrong. Assistant is off unless a key is configured.

sources.name: AfroTools Nigeria agriculture dataset
sources.limitations: The site itself calls this a planning reference, not agronomic advice, citing FAO/CGIAR/extension sources without giving specifics. Not an official government dataset. Rainfall figures are broad zone averages, not a measurement for any farm. Used here only for the zone-to-state grouping and each zone's commonly grown crops.

sources.name: NAFDAC pesticide ban announcements (as reported by Tech Economy and The Guardian Nigeria)
sources.limitations: News reports of NAFDAC announcements, not the official gazette. 12 further active ingredients are under a phase-out plan but not named in the sources. Confirm with NAFDAC.

sources.name: Tarfa et al. 2017, Optimizing Fertilizer Use within the Context of ISFM in Nigeria (OFRA), Table 12.4
sources.limitations: Only the 'apply no P (Bray-1 P above 15 mg/kg) / no K (exchangeable K above 0.17 cmol/kg)' levels are used. Single source, not agronomist-reviewed. Its fertiliser rate tables are NOT built into the app.

sources.name: IITA, Guide to Maize Production in Northern Nigeria
sources.license: Published guide, linked and summarised, not copied
sources.limitations: Source of the task timings in the Smart Planting Calendar. Where the guide gives no number the app labels the date a 'planning default'. Summaries were checked by reading, not by an agronomist.

sources.name: IITA, Guide to Cowpea Production in Northern Nigeria
sources.license: Published guide, linked and summarised, not copied
sources.limitations: Source of the task timings in the Smart Planting Calendar. Where the guide gives no number the app labels the date a 'planning default'. Summaries were checked by reading, not by an agronomist.
